FEAT-1-STORY-006.title: Define provider search schema and validation models
FEAT-1-STORY-006.description: Implement and validate Pydantic models for provider search inputs (query, specialty, location filters) and structured outputs to ensure consistent contract between tool router, facade, and domain services.

FEAT-1-STORY-007.title: Implement provider search core logic with fallback
FEAT-1-STORY-007.description: Build core provider search logic using vector search (MongoDB Atlas embeddings) with taxonomy fallback via NUCC codes, including location filtering and multi-stage narrowing (state, city, county).

FEAT-1-STORY-008.title: Integrate facade orchestration for provider search
FEAT-1-STORY-008.description: Wire provider search flow through find_care_facade to orchestrate specialty identification, query expansion, and provider search service calls, returning normalized results.

FEAT-1-STORY-009.title: Add unit and integration tests for provider search
FEAT-1-STORY-009.description: Create tests to validate vector search results, taxonomy fallback behavior, location filtering accuracy, and end-to-end tool invocation through tool_router.
